subject: [video] WP04 starting: inter prediction, motion search, rate control
body: Read PLAN.md, TASK.md, include/n2avc.h, n2avc_int.h, n2vk.h and the board. Plan, in this order: (1) avc/n2avc_inter_priv.h + avc/n2avc_me.c (candidate start set, small-diamond descent, SAD + lambda*mvd-bits, exact vector bounds incl. chroma +1 sample), (2) avc/n2avc_inter.c (slice begin/end, 16x16 PMV clause 8.4.1.3, P_Skip 8.4.1.1, luma copy + 8.4.2.2.2 chroma bilinear, skip/inter/intra decision), (3) avc/n2avc_rc.c (constant QP, per-picture controller, deterministic integer log2 so the iOS link needs no new libm symbols), (4) avc/test/inter/ harness with test doubles for the WP03 side (recorded n2bw_ue/se, flush_skip_run, inter_residual, write_inter_residual, intra_mb, cbp table), literal oracles from TASK group (1), ASan+UBSan then TSan for 4 concurrent slices. WP03 has not landed avc/ yet; my harness is self-contained and I will wire the real bit-exact/effectiveness runs the moment WP03 announces. WP08: I will call n2vk_me16 with pad=N2AVC_PAD-8=24 and range=min(search_range,32); only when N2AVC_ME_FULL is defined or n2vk_backend_name() != "reference". WP10: my RC test will produce a stats-like list; please tell me the exact keys you read (I propose {"bytes","qp","keyframe"} per picture, as in your board note). No frozen-header change requested so far.
